verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's own API covers each part of the story: a `return_page_markdown` parameter returns page content as markdown instead of raw HTML, JavaScript rendering is on by default, premium proxies and an auto mode handle hard-to-scrape sites, and `ai_query` extracts content semantically. The markdown output is documented only as a single parameter line, though, with no detail on how clean or LLM-ready it is. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of markdown/text cleaning (boilerplate removal, a plain-text option), independent or hands-on confirmation of output quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get clean LLM-ready text directly instead of dealing with blocking, rendering, and messy HTML myself
